# Core Summary
A 15-second 2D vector animation transitioning from adult workplace stress to childhood warmth through a Wahaha AD Calcium Milk bottle as an emotional switch. The clip uses a micro-arc structure (Hook → Escalation → Payoff) across 4 distinct shots with progressive pacing acceleration. Shot 1 establishes gray-toned office pressure with the bottle as focal point. Shot 2 reveals the cap-opening moment with particle effects triggering color transition. Shot 3 escalates through quick-cut nostalgia scenes. Shot 4 resolves with 30th anniversary branding and slogan payoff.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:04]
Late-night office desk environment. Cool gray-blue ambient lighting (#8A9BAE dominant). Computer monitor emits cold white glow casting sharp shadows across desk surface. Wooden desk texture with scattered papers, keyboard edge visible. Background blurred with shallow depth of field. Window shows dark night sky with distant city lights bokeh.

[shot2][00:04-00:07]
Extreme close-up on bottle cap area. Background transitions from gray to warm gradient (#F2A6B3 pink to #3A7D44 green). Soft cloud illustrations and paper airplane silhouettes emerge in background layer. Radial wipe effect creates liquid ripple transition.

[shot3][00:07-00:11]
Three quick-cut environment shifts: (1) Study desk with open books, warm lamp light. (2) Subway car interior, window reflection, soft motion blur. (3) Playground scene with warm sunset orange tones. Each environment maintains 2D flat vector style consistency.

[shot4][00:11-00:15]
Clean white background with golden accent (#C9A227). Five bottle variants arranged in semi-circle arc. Central 30th anniversary badge position center-frame. Safe zone margins: top/bottom ≥12%, left/right ≥8% for subtitle placement.

**Audio Description**: BGM: 120BPM Lo-fi chill hop, warm piano + light drums, -14 LUFS integrated loudness. SFX layers: cap open (咔哒+嘶), bubble pop (啵啵 with 0.05s room reverb), page turn, subway ambience (-15dB bed). All SFX on independent tracks.

# Subjects Description
<ID_A> (Protagonist)
- Gender: Female
- Race/Ethnicity: East Asian
- Age: Young adult (22-26)
- Appearance features: Shoulder-length black hair, simple ponytail. Light gray office shirt. Minimal makeup, tired eye bags visible in opening shot. Clothing transitions to casual warm-toned sweater in nostalgia sequence.
- Vocal Characteristics: N/A (no dialogue)

<ID_B> (Childhood Self)
- Gender: Female
- Race/Ethnicity: East Asian
- Age: Child (6-8)
- Appearance features: Short black hair with red ribbon. Colorful kindergarten outfit. Holding AD Calcium Milk bottle with both hands. Bright smile, rosy cheeks.
- Vocal Characteristics: N/A (no dialogue)

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:04]
Medium close-up, eye-level. <ID_A> sits at desk, right hand enters frame from right side, grips green AD Calcium Milk bottle positioned center-left. Screen cold light reflects on face showing fatigue (slight frown, lowered eyelids). Camera slowly pushes in (Dolly In 5%). Bottle cap begins counter-clockwise rotation. Micro-particle glow generates around cap edge (Repeater 3 cycles, opacity 60%→90%). Background hue shifts +15° toward warmer tone over 3 seconds ease-in. SFX: cap click + hiss sound (-3dB attack, EQ high-frequency +2dB). On-screen text appears center: 「累了吗？」 (Source Han Sans CN, white with 1px black stroke).

[shot2][00:04-00:07]
Extreme close-up on bottle mouth. Cap fully opens. Liquid transforms into pink/green/gold bubbles rising upward along custom Bezier paths with easeOut curve. Bubbles ≤30 particles, controlled via Trim Paths growth animation. Background radial wipe + liquid ripple Luma Matte erases gray tone, revealing warm illustration layer (clouds, paper airplanes). Camera tilts up slightly following bubble trajectory. SFX: bubble pop sounds (-6dB, 0.05s room reverb). BGM enters (120BPM Lo-fi, -14 LUFS). Subtitle fades in bottom-left safe zone (≥12% margin): 「那就允许自己，甜一下。」 (character-by-character reveal).

[shot3][00:07-00:11]
Fast-cut montage, 3 scenes at ~1.3s each. Scene 1: <ID_A> closes book, warm desk lamp, head tilts back slightly drinking. Scene 2: <ID_A> leans on subway window, reflection visible, slight Y-axis sine loop ±5px for motion feel. Scene 3: <ID_B> holds bottle up smiling, playground background. All transitions use Directional Blur (angle 180°, blur 15) — no hard cuts. Camera energy increases: handheld subtle shake on scene 2, stable on scene 3. BGM drum pattern accelerates. SFX: page flip + subway rumble (-15dB bed layer). Center subtitle with pink stroke (#F2A6B3): 「酸酸甜甜，懂你可可爱爱。」

[shot4][00:11-00:15]
Wide static shot. Five flavor bottle variants float along "time trajectory" arc path, opacity breathing 60%↔90%. Central 30th anniversary badge grows via Trim Paths (stroke 0→100%). Overlay mode: Screen. Camera slowly pulls out (Pull Out 8%) to reveal full composition. Golden particle sparkle around badge (#C9A227). Final frame holds 0.5s for brand lockup. BGM adds warm pad layer, fades out last 0.3s. No subtitle — brand visual only.

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
- Visual Style: 2D flat vector animation, Lottie-friendly. Clean shapes, minimal gradients. No heavy 3D or photorealistic elements.
- Color Palette: Opening #8A9BAE (pressure gray-blue) → Transition #F2A6B3 (warm pink) + #3A7D44 (nostalgia green) → Finale #C9A227 (30th gold).
- Lighting: Flat ambient with selective rim highlights on bottles. No dramatic shadows. Bright luminous default with layered depth via color contrast.
- Texture: Smooth vector edges, subtle grain overlay for warmth. Particle effects use additive blending.
- Image Quality: 1920×1080, 25fps, H.264/MP4. Safe zone compliance for subtitle placement.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
Emotional progression moves from workplace fatigue and isolation to nostalgic warmth and self-acceptance. The bottle cap opening functions as an "emotional switch" — a physical trigger for psychological release. Tone remains light, playful, and non-preachy throughout. Final feeling: gentle companionship, permission to be childlike, brand as emotional anchor rather than product push. Target viewer response: "This understands me" rather than "This sells to me."
